# latent-opencode

Earn while your agent works, without leaving your own OpenCode TUI (v2.2+).
One labelled sponsored line sits in the prompt footer during a turn. The
plugin only draws in the terminal: it never reads or changes the model's
request or reply.

    opencode plugin add latent-opencode

| Command | |
| --- | --- |
| `/latent` | wallet, credit balance, sponsored line on/off |
| `/latent-login` | connect the wallet Earn pays into |
| `/latent-open` | open the sponsored link |

When a turn fails on your plan's usage limit and you have credit, a toast
points at the Latent provider ("Latent · via Venice" in `/models`: Venice
models paid from your credits), which `npx latentcode login` adds to the
shared OpenCode config.

The wallet is shared with every Latent surface (`~/.latent-protocol`), so a
login from `npx latentcode login` works here too. Prefer a dedicated app?
`npx latentcode`.
